cards.ex: The president hesitated to put boots on the ground in the conflict.
cards.exUz: Prezident mojaro hududiga askar kiritishga ikkilandi.
cards.uzDef: Urush zonasida askarlar mavjudligi, ayniqsa quruqlikda.

cards.ex: The military tried to minimize collateral damage during the bombing raid.
cards.exUz: Harbiylar bomba hujumi paytida tasodifiy zararni kamaytirishga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Urushda nishonga tegishli bo'lmagan, tinch aholiga yetkazilgan zarar.

cards.ex: Several soldiers were injured due to friendly fire during the battle.
cards.exUz: Jang paytida bir necha askar o'z o'qi tufayli yaralandi.
cards.uzDef: Urush paytida o'z askarlarining o'qidan o'lish yoki yaralanish.

cards.ex: The war-torn country struggled to rebuild its infrastructure.
cards.exUz: Urush vayron qilgan mamlakat infratuzilmasini tiklashga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Urush natijasida katta zarar ko'rgan, vayron bo'lgan hudud.

cards.ex: The speech was a call to arms for all patriots.
cards.exUz: Nutq barcha vatanparvarlar uchun urushga chaqiriq edi.
cards.uzDef: Urushga tayyorlanish yoki urushga qo'shilish uchun ochiq chaqiriq.

cards.ex: The army strengthened its lines of defense along the border.
cards.exUz: Armiya chegara bo'ylab mudofaa chiziqlarini kuchaytirdi.
cards.uzDef: Dushmanga qarshi mudofaa uchun qurilgan pozitsiyalar yoki to'siqlar.

cards.ex: He served on the front lines for three years.
cards.exUz: U uch yil davomida front chizig'ida xizmat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Urushda dushman bilan bevosita to'qnashuv joyida.

cards.ex: The rebels managed to take several soldiers prisoner.
cards.exUz: Isyonchilar bir nechta askarni asirga olishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Dushmanni jang paytida qo'lga olib, asir sifatida ushlab turish.

cards.ex: They called a truce to allow civilians to evacuate.
cards.exUz: Ular tinch aholini evakuatsiya qilish uchun sulh e'lon qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Urushayotgan tomonlar o'rtasida vaqtincha urushni to'xtatish kelishuvi.

cards.ex: The negotiations reached a stalemate, with neither side willing to compromise.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar hech bir tomon murosaga kelishni istamaganligi sababli, teng vaziyatga kelib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Hech bir tomon g'alaba qozona olmaydigan, harakat yo'q vaziyat.

cards.ex: Many civilians sought refuge in neighboring countries.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab tinch aholi qo'shni davlatlardan boshpana izlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Urushdan yoki xavfdan qochib, xavfsiz joy izlash.

cards.ex: Decisions were made in the fog of war, with limited information.
cards.exUz: Qarorlar urush tumani ichida, cheklangan ma'lumotlar bilan qabul qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Urush paytida ma'lumotlarning yetishmasligi yoki chalkashligi.

cards.ex: The general tried to rally the troops before the final battle.
cards.exUz: General so'nggi jang oldidan qo'shinni safarbar qilishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Askarlarni ruhlantirish, bir maqsadga erishish uchun kuchlarini birlashtirish.

cards.ex: Everyone contributed to the war effort during the conflict.
cards.exUz: Mojaro paytida hamma urush harakatiga hissa qo'shdi.
cards.uzDef: Urushni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun qilingan barcha sa'y-harakatlar.

cards.ex: The city was under siege for several months.
cards.exUz: Shahar bir necha oy davomida qamal ostida edi.
cards.uzDef: Dushman qo'shinlari tomonidan qurshab olingan, qamal qilingan.

cards.ex: They discovered a hidden weapons stockpile in the forest.
cards.exUz: Ular o'rmonda yashirin qurol omborini topishdi.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqdordagi qurol-yarog' va o'q-dorilar zaxirasi.

cards.ex: The UN decided to deploy troops to the region to maintain peace.
cards.exUz: BMT tinchlikni saqlash uchun mintaqaga qo'shin joylashtirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Askarlarni urush yoki harbiy operatsiya uchun bir joydan boshqa joyga o'tkazish.

cards.ex: There was a brief skirmish between the two patrols.
cards.exUz: Ikki patrul o'rtasida qisqa to'qnashuv bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, qisqa muddatli jang yoki to'qnashuv.

cards.ex: The rules of engagement were carefully reviewed to avoid civilian casualties.
cards.exUz: Tinch aholi qurbonlarining oldini olish uchun jang qoidalari diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqildi.
cards.uzDef: Harbiylar urush paytida rioya qilishi kerak bo'lgan qoidalar.

cards.ex: The conflict turned into a war of attrition, with heavy losses on both sides.
cards.exUz: Mojaro qirg'in urushiga aylanib, har ikki tomonda katta yo'qotishlar bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etadigan, resurslarni tugatishga qaratilgan urush.

cards.ex: They won the battle, but the war was far from over.
cards.exUz: Ular jangda g'alaba qozonishdi, ammo urush hali tugamagan edi.
cards.uzDef: Bir jangda g'alaba qozonish, lekin urushni hali yakunlamaslik.

cards.ex: The government tried to win the hearts and minds of the people in the occupied territory.
cards.exUz: Hukumat bosib olingan hududdagi aholining qalbini va ongini qozonishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Aholining ishonchini va qo'llab-quvvatlashini qozonishga qaratilgan harakat.

cards.ex: Both sides signed a ceasefire agreement to end the fighting.
cards.exUz: Tomonlar jangni to'xtatish uchun o't ochishni to'xtatish haqidagi kelishuvga imzo chekishdi.
cards.uzDef: Urushayotgan tomonlar o'rtasida o't ochishni to'xtatish haqidagi kelishuv.

cards.ex: The demilitarized zone separated the two countries.
cards.exUz: Demilitarizatsiya hududi ikki davlatni ajratib turardi.
cards.uzDef: Harbiy kuchlar va qurollar bo'lmagan hudud.

cards.ex: He went AWOL after becoming disillusioned with the war.
cards.exUz: U urushdan hafsalasi pir bo'lganidan keyin ruxsatsiz ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Harbiy xizmatchining ruxsatsiz, qonuniy sababsiz tark etishi.

cards.ex: The military conducted war games to prepare for potential threats.
cards.exUz: Harbiylar potentsial tahdidlarga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun harbiy o'yinlar o'tkazishdi.
cards.uzDef: Harbiy strategiyalarni sinovdan o'tkazish uchun o'tkaziladigan mashqlar.

cards.ex: The military launched a surgical strike to destroy the terrorist camp.
cards.exUz: Harbiylar terroristik lagerini yo'q qilish uchun aniq zarba berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan nishonga aniqlik bilan qilingan hujum, tasodifiy zararni kamaytirishga qaratilgan.

cards.ex: The enemy base was a hard target, heavily fortified.
cards.exUz: Dushman bazasi qattiq himoyalangan, qiyin nishon edi.
cards.uzDef: Himoyalangan, yo'q qilish qiyin bo'lgan nishon.

cards.ex: Sending in more troops could escalate the conflict.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq qo'shin yuborish mojaroni kuchaytirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Mojaroning shiddatini oshirish, kengroq va jiddiyroq qilish.

cards.ex: The aid program aimed to win hearts and minds in the region.
cards.exUz: Yordam dasturi mintaqada qalb va ongni egallashga qaratilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Aholining ishonchini va qo'llab-quvvatlashini qozonish.
